title: 从能够控制到值得被演奏｜BPM System 之后
titleEn: From Control to Performance — After BPM System
summary: 从 TIMER、Drop Flow、ENTROPY 到 REACTOR，评估实时视觉实践已经形成的系统组织能力、音乐理解与作品完成度的缺口，并提出可复演、可比较、可验证的下一阶段标准。
summaryEn: A critical follow-up to BPM System 2026: assessing live-system maturity, gaps in musical and artistic judgement, and the next steps toward repeatable audiovisual works.
